//: Files failing each soft check of the pack-content gate (test/pack-content.test.mts). A count may only fall, and the file must equal the measured count: the gate is red when a count is lower than the file holds, so lower it here when a fix lands. A check no file fails has no row. The hard checks have no row: they fail no file. A file edited on a branch must pass the whole set, so a file that fails a check a person judges (C5, R1, R7, S3 ...) is edited in one go for all its checks: C2, C7 and R6 are left in those files.
